{'text': '今日《時代雜誌》一篇新報道專訪咗行政總裁 John Ternus，亦同蘋果全球市場高級副總裁 Greg「Joz」Joswiak 傾過，佢談到矽谷 AI 嘅「狂熱極端派」、OpenAI 嘅硬件威脅等等。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today in a new story at TIME, the publication interviewed CEO John Ternus but also spoke to Greg “Joz” Joswiak, Apple’s SVP of Worldwide Marketing, who addressed the “lunatic fringe” of AI in Silicon Valley, hardware threats from OpenAI, and more.'}

{'text': '以下係 Greg Joswiak 對蘋果 AI 策略、OpenAI 威脅等嘅睇法', 'paragraph_context': 'Here’s what Greg Joswiak said about Apple’s AI strategy, threats from OpenAI, more'}

{'text': '《時代雜誌》將 iPhone Duo 選為 2026 年最佳發明之一，並就呢篇報道專訪咗行政總裁 John Ternus 同其他幾位蘋果高層。', 'paragraph_context': 'TIME picked the iPhone Duo as one of 2026’s best inventions and interviewed CEO John Ternus plus a few other Apple execs for the story.'}

{'text': '其中一位受訪者、全球市場高級副總裁 Greg Joswiak 就談到咗蘋果嘅 AI 策略、OpenAI 嘅硬件部署等等。', 'paragraph_context': 'One of those other interviewees, SVP of Worldwide Marketing Greg Joswiak, addressed Apple’s AI strategy, OpenAI hardware efforts, and more.'}

{'text': '當被問到 ChatGPT 開發商嘅硬件計劃時，Joswiak 表示：「我哋唔覺得受到威脅。我哋可以做嘅整合工作，代表我哋可以創造出比任何人更出色嘅體驗。」', 'paragraph_context': 'When asked about the ChatGPT maker’s hardware plans, Joswiak said: “We don’t feel threatened. The fact that we can do the integration that we can means we can create just a better experience than anybody else.”'}

{'text': '蘋果將硬件、軟件同服務整合一向係公司嘅產品核心理念。佢哋顯然相信，呢啲生態系統嘅優勢將會係抵禦新競爭對手嘅強大後盾。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple’s integration of hardware, software, and services has long been central to the company’s product ethos. And it clearly believes those ecosystem strengths will be a strong defense against new competitors.'}

{'text': 'Joswiak 同時暗示，OpenAI 嘅產品可能未必有蘋果裝置咁廣泛嘅吸引力。以下係報道緊隨其後嘅一段：', 'paragraph_context': 'Joswiak also implies that perhaps OpenAI’s products won’t have as broad appeal as Apple devices do. From the story’s very next paragraph:'}

{'text': 'Joswiak 補充話，蘋果並非為一班追逐超級智能嘅 AI 狂熱信徒而製造產品。「我哋好鍾意佢哋，佢哋都可以用，但佢哋唔係我哋嘅目標客群。」佢話：「我哋嘅目標係點樣令一般大眾有更好體驗。」', 'paragraph_context': 'Joswiak adds that Apple isn’t making products for the die-hard AI believers chasing superintelligence. “We love them, and they can use it too, but that’s not our target,” he says. “It’s how to make it better for everyday people.”'}

{'text': 'Joswiak 喺訪問其他部分亦提及一般人同 AI 發燒友之間嘅呢種區分。Andrew Chow 寫道：', 'paragraph_context': 'This sort of split between the average person and the AI enthusiast is also highlighted by Joswiak elsewhere in the interview. Andrew Chow writes:'}

{'text': '雖然蘋果有自行訓練模型，但佢哋嘅技術距離最前沿仲有好遠，一旦超聰明 AI 喺未來幾年改變行業同社會，呢間公司有可能被拋離……不過 Ternus 同其他蘋果高層都話唔擔心。喺一場民粹式反 AI 浪潮之中，佢哋認為自己正在建構一種規模適中、貼身個人化、保障私隱嘅 AI，能夠真正幫助普通人，而唔係只係令矽谷嘅「狂熱極端派」眼花繚亂——全球市場高級副總裁 Greg Joswiak 就係咁形容嘅。', 'paragraph_context': 'While Apple trains its own models, it is nowhere near the technology’s frontier, leaving the company vulnerable to being left behind if super-smart AI transforms industry and society in the coming years…But Ternus and other Apple executives say they aren’t concerned. In the midst of a populist AI backlash, they contend that they are building a modest but personalized and privacy-preserving form of AI that will actually help ordinary people as opposed to merely dazzling Silicon Valley’s “lunatic fringe,” as Greg Joswiak, senior vice president of worldwide marketing, puts it.'}

{'text': 'Joswiak 並未為「狂熱極端派」下定義，但透過將其同蘋果「幫助普通人」嘅做法作出對比，佢清楚劃出咗一條界線。', 'paragraph_context': 'Joswiak doesn’t define this “lunatic fringe,” but by contrasting it with Apple’s own efforts to “help ordinary people,” he’s making a clear distinction.'}
